03/13/2025 10:35 AM UTC-07/ ReAnne Oriel - Hi Anthony,
I opened up a ticket with Datto to see if they are able to find the issue. After troubleshooting, we both realized that the issue is the order of the applications that were getting installed. Singlewire takes the longest to install and If Singlewire gets stuck, then it does not install TeamViewer. I changed the order and tested it and it did install TeamViewer successfully first. Please let me know if you continue to run into issues with TeamViewer when onboarding later on!
Thank you, ReAnne Oriel
